description: Nine occupational roles with distinct silhouette rules, silhouette tokens, light codes, and faction livery bindings.

miner.label: Mining Rig
miner.signatureVerb: Cuts and crabs relative to the rock face; extracts ore under amber work floods.
miner.hardwareProtagonist: Asymmetric extraction arms forward (port cutter, starboard scoop), underslung dust hopper/filter drums.
miner.asymmetry: Heavy port cutter boom, offset collector throat, unilateral debris skirt.

lightCode.meaning: Mass and cutting; blind cone at seam

miner.hazardMarking: Amber chevrons on arm knuckles, hazard border on hopper lips.

behaviorSignature.tacticalTell: Squat industrial work frame; sluggish loaded turn authority; clings to ore face.

customs.label: Customs Cutter
customs.signatureVerb: Enforces inspection corridors; locks steady arc-blue inspection bar on selected contact.
customs.hardwareProtagonist: Squared inspection emitter collar around bow ('judge's collar'), dorsal sensor fin, boarding clamp.
customs.asymmetry: Strict axial symmetry; bilateral inspection collar with central sensor fin.
customs.hazardMarking: High-contrast lighted registry stencils, zero illicit tag space.

behaviorSignature.tacticalTell: Sleek angular wedge wearing a judge's collar; fast station-keeping; locks arc-blue sweep bar.

heavy.label: Bulk Hauler
heavy.signatureVerb: Moves massive cargo pods along logistics lanes; slow to correct momentum.
heavy.hardwareProtagonist: Massive rectangular open-truss spine loaded with modular cargo pods, gigantic aft drive block.
heavy.asymmetry: Alternating pod clamps, offset fuel feed raceways, high forward bridge cab.
heavy.hazardMarking: Volatile cargo bands, yellow/black load stripe on pod latching frames.

behaviorSignature.tacticalTell: Gigantic rectangular slab; slow arrival deceleration; high linear inertia.

courier.label: Priority Courier
courier.signatureVerb: Flies rapid tangent passes on priority contracts; commits through without loitering.
courier.hardwareProtagonist: Needle-sharp aerodynamic delta wedge, high-sweep wings, oversized central thruster cone.
courier.asymmetry: Clean bilateral dart lines; faired flush surfaces with zero external pods.
courier.hazardMarking: Reflective leading-edge speed chevrons, dispatch crest.

behaviorSignature.tacticalTell: Knife-edge dart; high thrust-to-mass; immediate roll-and-burn evasion.

salvor.label: Salvage Cutter
salvor.signatureVerb: Breaks dead hulks in relative hold; cuts with hooded lamps down-aimed.
salvor.hardwareProtagonist: Starboard hydraulic plate-shears, 3 overhead hooded umbrella lamps, aft scrap cradle.
salvor.asymmetry: Massive starboard shears, port gas/foam cylinder stack, asymmetrical umbrella boom arms.

lightCode.meaning: Salvage in progress; hooded confession light

salvor.hazardMarking: Scorched jaw knuckles, yellow/black hazard hatching on shear rams.

behaviorSignature.tacticalTell: Ragged silhouette with downward umbrellas; stays with the wreck; does not scatter.

surveyor.label: Survey Rig
surveyor.signatureVerb: Crabs 90° across uncharted belts; reads the dark with periodic pulse rings.
surveyor.hardwareProtagonist: Stepped dorsal sensor spine, high oval array paddles, 90° crab survey pin boom.
surveyor.asymmetry: Forward survey pin crabs 90° off-axis; chin range-mast cluster offset from dorsal boom.

lightCode.meaning: Reading the dark; scanner pulse rings

surveyor.hazardMarking: Sensor calibration scales, stamped survey quadrant plate.

behaviorSignature.tacticalTell: Flies sideways under wide paddles; keeps boom between stranger and belly; slides away.

tender.label: Repair Tender
tender.signatureVerb: Provides mobile field repairs; holds soft relative drift with red corners lit.
tender.hardwareProtagonist: Port curved vertical plate rack, starboard articulated welding crane with lamp head, 4 red corners.
tender.asymmetry: Extreme left/right split: entire port side is plate rack, entire starboard is weld boom.

lightCode.meaning: Hull open; personnel outside; do not push

tender.hazardMarking: Safety-yellow bay lips, swing-out white 'DO NOT PUSH' engine bar.

behaviorSignature.tacticalTell: Broad flat workshop frame; plate rack looks like books; stationary zero-drift hold.

tug.label: Yard Tug
tug.signatureVerb: Nudges heavy tonnage into dock alignment; provides short high-thrust contact bursts.
tug.hardwareProtagonist: Heavy bow push-cradle with padded vertical ribs, hip nudge-keels with replaceable shoes, aft winch.
tug.asymmetry: Blunt flat nose with vertical ribbing, hip skids flanking low bilges, high forward bridge.
tug.hazardMarking: Apron-yellow nose, high-friction abrasion on contact pads.

behaviorSignature.tacticalTell: Short blunt powerhouse; oversized drives; touches client with push-cradle ticks.

rescue.label: Rescue Lifter
rescue.signatureVerb: Answers emergency beacons; approaches with steady red-white identity bars and searchlights.
rescue.hardwareProtagonist: Forward casualty bay with soft-dock padded jaws, dorsal stretcher boom, flank identity light bars.
rescue.asymmetry: Forward casualty mouth flanked by soft padding; dorsal boom equipped with rescue basket.
rescue.hazardMarking: Sanctioned red-white rescue bars along full flanks, reflective emergency chevrons.

behaviorSignature.tacticalTell: Flies steady red-white flank bars; fast direct approach; floodlights light debris.
